lead.titleZh: 老年、神经与骨科各有 RCT 或观察研究，聚焦抗阻、吞咽、肩痛康复
lead.titleEn: RCTs and Observational Studies in Geriatric, Neurological, and Orthopedic Rehab
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 6 篇条目，涵盖 4 个专业方向。最高 curatedScore 为 75 分，有 4 篇 RCT 和 1 篇观察研究达到此分，分别聚焦老年女性抗阻训练、卒中后吞咽困难、非创伤性肩痛及慢性腰痛，其中老年女性抗阻训练和卒中后吞咽困难均为 RCT，而肩痛康复则为观察研究。另有 1 篇系统综述关注非特异性颈痛的诊断准确性。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's edition features 6 entries across 4 specialties. The highest curatedScore of 75 includes 4 RCTs and 1 observational study, focusing on resistance training for older women, post-stroke dysphagia, non-traumatic shoulder pain, and chronic low back pain. The resistance training and dysphagia studies are RCTs, while the shoulder pain rehabilitation is an observational study. Additionally, there is 1 systematic review on the diagnostic accuracy of tests for non-specific neck pain.

items.title: Hybrid versus in-clinic rehabilitation for non-traumatic shoulder pain within a standardized digital care pathway: a prospective longitudinal observational study
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal observational study of 164 rehabilitation episodes for non-traumatic shoulder pain found no clear between-modality difference in time to documented clinical discharge or secondary outcomes between hybrid (1 in-clinic, 2 home sessions/week) and in-clinic (3 in-clinic sessions/week) rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，对于非创伤性肩痛患者，混合康复（每周一次诊所，两次居家）与纯诊所康复（每周三次诊所）在达到临床出院时间和功能结果上差异不大。这支持了远程康复在某些情况下能提供与面对面康复类似的效果，为你的服务模式提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 标准化数字护理路径中混合式康复与诊所内康复治疗非创伤性肩痛的对比：一项前瞻性纵向观察性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对非创伤性肩痛的纵向观察性研究（164 例）发现，混合式康复（每周 1 次诊所，2 次居家）与纯诊所内康复（每周 3 次诊所）在达到临床出院时间和次要结局方面没有明显差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that for non-traumatic shoulder pain, hybrid rehabilitation (one in-clinic, two home sessions weekly) shows no clear difference in time to clinical discharge and functional outcomes compared to in-clinic rehabilitation (three in-clinic sessions weekly). This supports remote rehab as a comparable option to in-person care in certain situations, informing your service delivery models.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机分配的观察性研究，存在残余混杂和潜在的信息性删失，无法确立等效性、非劣效性或因果比较效果。
items.limitationEn: This was a non-randomized observational study, susceptible to residual confounding and potentially informative censoring, precluding conclusions on equivalence, non-inferiority, or causal comparative effectiveness.

items.title: Effect of bimodal signal biofeedback on the supraglottic swallowing maneuver in patients with post-stroke dysphagia: A randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effect of bimodal signal biofeedback, combining an accelerometer and a nasal airflow sensor, on the supraglottic swallowing maneuver in patients with post-stroke dysphagia.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提出了针对卒中后吞咽困难患者的创新性生物反馈方案，将加速度计与鼻气流传感器结合，有望提高声门上吞咽动作的有效性。这对你评估和干预这类患者提供了新的思路。
items.titleZh: 双模式信号生物反馈对卒中后吞咽困难患者声门上吞咽动作的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验旨在调查结合加速度计和鼻气流传感器的双模式信号生物反馈对卒中后吞咽困难患者声门上吞咽动作的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT introduces an innovative biofeedback approach for post-stroke dysphagia, combining an accelerometer and nasal airflow sensor to potentially enhance the supraglottic swallowing maneuver. It offers a new perspective for assessing and intervening in these patients.
items.limitation: 试验的具体方法学和结果细节未提供，无法评估研究设计的全面性和结果的精确性。
items.limitationEn: Specific methodological and detailed results were not provided, preventing a comprehensive evaluation of the study design and precision of outcomes.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Elastic band resistance training improves physical function, gait, cardiac indices, and corticomuscular coherence in older women at risk of sarcopenia: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In 40 older women at risk of sarcopenia, 12 weeks of elastic band resistance training significantly improved muscle strength, physical function, gait parameters (increased stride length, reduced double-support time), and corticomuscular coherence, alongside positive changes in cardiac morphology and function.
items.curatedReason: 对社区中存在肌少症风险的老年女性，弹力带抗阻训练 12 周能显著提升肌肉力量、改善步态，甚至对心脏形态和功能也有积极影响。这些数据充分支持我们将弹力带作为一种安全、经济有效的居家训练手段，推广给我们的肌少症高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 弹力带抗阻训练改善存在肌少症风险的老年女性的身体功能、步态、心脏指标和皮质肌肉相干性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 对 40 名有肌少症风险的老年女性进行为期 12 周的弹力带抗阻训练，显著改善了肌肉力量、身体功能、步态参数（增加步幅、减少双支撑时间）和皮质肌肉相干性，同时心脏形态和功能也出现积极变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older women at risk of sarcopenia in the community, 12 weeks of elastic band resistance training significantly improves muscle strength, gait, and even shows positive effects on cardiac morphology and function. These data strongly support prescribing elastic bands as a safe, cost-effective home exercise modality for our sarcopenia-at-risk patients.
items.limitation: 本研究虽然是 RCT，但并未直接证明心-脑-肌网络的整合调节，而是观察到了平行适应。
items.limitationEn: Although an RCT, this study observed parallel adaptations rather than directly demonstrating integrated regulation of the heart-brain-muscle network.

items.title: Effectiveness of Kalevala Manual Therapy, Health Coaching, and Physiotherapy for Chronic Low Back Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial (The INTEGRA Trial)
items.summary: In a three-arm RCT with 81 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain, Kalevala Manual Therapy (KMT) and KMT combined with health coaching (KMT+HC) showed comparable improvements in pain and functional disability to guideline-based physiotherapy, with KMT+HC also significantly reducing work-related fear-avoidance beliefs.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示 Kalevala 手法治疗（KMT）及其结合健康指导（KMT+HC）在慢性腰痛的疼痛和功能障碍改善上，与指南推荐的物理治疗效果相当。值得关注的是，KMT+HC 还能显著降低与工作相关的恐惧回避信念，这表明综合性行为支持对手法治疗的补充价值。
items.titleZh: Kalevala 手法治疗、健康指导和物理治疗对慢性腰痛的有效性：一项随机对照试验（INTEGRA 试验）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 81 名非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的三臂随机对照试验显示，Kalevala 手法治疗（KMT）和 KMT 结合健康指导（KMT+HC）在改善疼痛和功能障碍方面与指南推荐的物理治疗效果相当，且 KMT+HC 显著降低了与工作相关的恐惧回避信念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT with 81 chronic low back pain patients tells us that if you're using Kalevala Manual Therapy (KMT), its effects on pain and disability are comparable to guideline-based physiotherapy. What's more compelling is that KMT combined with health coaching (KMT+HC) significantly reduced work-related fear-avoidance beliefs, suggesting that integrating behavioral support into manual therapy is a solid approach.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，样本量相对较小（81 例），且缺乏长期随访数据，可能限制了结果的普遍性和长期有效性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center trial with a relatively small sample size (81 participants) and lacked long-term follow-up, which may limit the generalizability and long-term efficacy of the results.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy and discriminative validity of clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests in adults with nonspecific neck pain: a systematic review
items.summary: This systematic review of 18 studies found that clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests may help characterize impairment patterns in adults with nonspecific neck pain within sensorimotor, muscle-performance, and movement-control domains, but direct clinical diagnostic-accuracy evidence is lacking, and tests should be adjuncts rather than standalone tools.
items.curatedReason: 现有证据表明，物理治疗师实施的检查测试有助于表征非特异性颈痛患者的损伤模式，尤其是在感觉运动、肌肉表现和特定运动控制方面。但这些测试缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据，应作为多模式临床评估的辅助手段，而非独立诊断工具。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师实施的检查测试对非特异性颈痛成人诊断准确性和鉴别有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对 18 项研究的系统综述发现，物理治疗师实施的检查测试可能有助于表征非特异性颈痛成人患者的感觉运动、肌肉表现和运动控制方面的损伤模式，但缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据，应将其作为辅助而非独立的诊断工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current evidence suggests that clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests can help characterize impairment patterns in adults with non-specific neck pain, particularly in sensorimotor, muscle performance, and movement control domains. However, these tests lack direct clinical diagnostic accuracy evidence and should be interpreted as adjuncts within a multimodal clinical assessment, not standalone diagnostic tools.
items.limitation: 现有研究大多比较颈痛患者与无症状对照组，缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据。
items.limitationEn: Most available evidence comes from studies comparing people with neck pain against asymptomatic controls, lacking direct clinical diagnostic accuracy evidence.

items.title: Do Subsamples Provide Reproducibility Estimates Comparable to the Full Sample in Trial-Based Ultrasound Muscle Measurements?
items.summary: This study explores whether subsamples provide reproducibility estimates comparable to the full sample in trial-based ultrasound muscle measurements.
items.curatedReason: 这份观察研究的意义在于，它提出在进行超声肌肉测量可重复性研究时，不必每次都收集全样本数据，小样本可能已足够。这可以帮我们节省研究时间和资源，但对临床超声测量操作本身并无直接影响。
items.titleZh: 子样本在基于试验的超声肌肉测量中能否提供与全样本相当的可重复性估计？
items.summaryZh: 本研究探讨了在基于试验的超声肌肉测量中，子样本是否能提供与全样本相当的可重复性估计。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that when evaluating the reproducibility of ultrasound muscle measurements, you might not always need full sample data; subsamples could be sufficient. This could save research time and resources, though it doesn't directly change how we perform clinical ultrasound measurements.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science
